title: FOLLOW-UP: hoist container-root guard into lib workspace registry repoRoot
summary: U3 added a container-root guard in routes/meta.js POST /workspace: the repoRoot climb adopts a strict ancestor only when that ancestor is not a filesystem container root (os.tmpdir, os.homedir, fs root), so an incidental stray .graph/.git at a container root never re-homes a fresh top-level workspace dir. This guard currently lives only in routes/meta.js, but the underlying repoRoot is the U1 lib function (lib/workspace-registry.repoRoot) called directly by hooks (U4) and CLI (U5) as well — those callers do not get the guard. FOLLOW-UP recommendation: consider hoisting the container-root exclusion into lib/workspace-registry.repoRoot so all callers share it. Not a kickback — U3 was scope-correct (only routes/meta.js in scope).
